title: Distinguishing Process Change, Instrument Fault and Data-Path Corruption in Streaming Telemetry: A Reference Implementation and Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.18904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A reading departs from what a monitoring system expects for one of three reasons: the physical process changed, the instrument is failing, or the value was corrupted between the instrument and the software. The three call for different responses and look alike in a single sample. We state the three-cause problem, prove which pairs of causes one channel cannot separate, and propose a bank of online detectors - a Kalman tracker with CUSUM and EWMA charts on its innovation, a Hampel median with generalized-ESD confirmation, a robust noise statistic with ADWIN, exact-value checks and an optional two-channel complementary filter - combined by a deterministic, inspectable attribution rule. The detectors were merged into a public algorithm library. On 2,942 injected events of thirteen fault types the method detects 96.3% (95% interval 95.7-97.0) at 0.22 false alarms per hour and attributes 91.2% (90.6-91.8) of detected events correctly from o

translated_title: 流式遥测中区分过程变化、仪器故障与数据通路损坏：参考实现与基准测试
translated_abstract: 监测系统的读数偏离预期有三种可能原因：物理过程发生了变化、仪器正在故障，或数值在仪器与软件之间的传输过程中被损坏。这三种情况需要不同的应对措施，但在单个样本中看起来相似。我们阐述了这一三成因问题，证明了单通道无法区分哪些成因对，并提出了一组在线检测器——包括基于新息序列上CUSUM和EWMA控制图的卡尔曼跟踪器、带广义ESD确认的Hampel中位数检测器、带ADWIN的鲁棒噪声统计量、精确值检查以及可选的双通道互补滤波器——并由一个确定性、可审查的归因规则进行组合。这些检测器已合并至一个公开的算法库中。在13种故障类型的2,942个注入事件上，该方法的检测率为96.3%（95%置信区间95.7-97.0），每小时误报0.22次，并从……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了一种由多种在线检测器与确定性、可审查的归因规则组合的方法，能在流式遥测中以96.3%的检测率和91.2%的正确归因率区分过程变化、仪器故障与数据通路损坏这三种异常成因。
en_tdlr: Proposes a bank of online detectors combined with a deterministic, inspectable attribution rule that distinguishes process change, instrument fault, and data-path corruption in streaming telemetry, achieving 96.3% detection with 91.2% correct attribution.
